answer: Spoken maps do not unlock a silt berth. After posting 17.6 POA, the applicant has 24 minutes to boat reach 4 of the outer delta, drop sampler SM-9 into marked hollow HL-12 at 1.8 m, and press relic tag RT-44 to the core sleeve for 50 seconds so magnetometer MG-3 holds 41.6 uT within 0.8 uT. A second sampler from the same key cluster, a lock miss over 1.5 uT, or a reused tag burns the 17.6 POA and bars silt berths for four epochs. Two bank clerks rehash the magnetometer file and RT-44 serial.
